_comment: Concierge source ledger. The concierge may ONLY answer from these entries and must cite them. Facts are structural (who decides what), not fees or processing times - those change and must be read from the official page on the day. checked_on stays null until a human re-reads the source.

entries.q: Who applies for a Cyprus work permit for a non-EU worker?
entries.a: For third-country nationals, the employer in Cyprus starts the process: the job normally needs Department of Labour approval for that sector, and the Civil Registry and Migration Department issues the entry and employment permit. The worker should not travel for work before the entry permit exists.

entries.q: Can a Pakistani worker get a work visa for Cyprus?
entries.a: Yes, but only through a real employer in Cyprus whose permit application is approved. On the Pakistan side, overseas employment goes through a BEOE-licensed Overseas Employment Promoter (or a BEOE direct-employment permission), and the worker registers with the Protector of Emigrants before leaving.

entries.q: How do I check if a recruiting agent in Pakistan is genuine?
entries.a: Ask for the OEP licence number and the BEOE permission (job) number, then look both up on the BEOE website yourself. Contact the OEP through the details listed by BEOE, not the phone number the agent gave you. If the agent will not give these numbers, treat the offer as high risk.

entries.q: Can I go on a tourist or visit visa and get a work permit after arriving?
entries.a: Do not do this. Working on a visit visa is not a lawful route and leads to removal and entry bans. The employment permit route has to be completed before you travel to work.

entries.q: How much does a Cyprus work visa cost?
entries.a: Official fees change, so MUSA does not quote them from memory. Ask the agent for an itemised breakdown that separates official government fees from their own service fees, then check each official fee on the authority's own website on the day you pay. Any amount that cannot be traced to an official page or a signed contract is unverified.

entries.q: Is Northern Cyprus the same as Cyprus for work permits?
entries.a: No. The Republic of Cyprus (an EU member) and the northern part of the island run separate immigration systems. A permit or offer for one does not cover the other, so treat any 'Cyprus' offer that routes through the north as a different case and verify it separately.

entries.q: How does the Cyprus student route work?
entries.a: Start with an admission from an accredited Cyprus institution (check its accreditation with CYQAA), then the student entry and residence permit through the Civil Registry and Migration Department, including proof of funds.

entries.q: Can my family join me in Cyprus?
entries.a: Family reunification depends on the sponsor's residence status and how long they have held it, plus accommodation and income requirements. The rules and documents are set by the Civil Registry and Migration Department, so check your exact category there.

entries.q: What are the warning signs of a visa scam?
entries.a: Common warning signs: a 'guaranteed' visa, pressure to pay today, payment into a personal account or mobile wallet, no receipt, no contract before payment, a fee to 'get an embassy appointment', offers to arrange bank statements or experience letters, or advice to travel on a visit visa. Paste the agent's message into Scam Shield to check it.

entries.q: How should I pay a recruiter?
entries.a: Pay only the registered company (the licensed OEP), never a personal account or wallet, and get an official receipt for every payment. Only pay against a written agreement that lists what each payment is for and what is refunded if the visa is refused.

MUSA checks job and visa offers before you pay: licence and permission checks, employer registry checks and a fee breakdown. MUSA does not sell jobs or visas and does not charge workers a placement fee. Hiring for employers runs through licensed agencies.

entries.q: How do I see or delete my data?
entries.a: You can ask for a copy of your data or ask us to delete it at any time from the privacy request page. We answer within one month, as the GDPR requires.
